ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (20) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).
«Осуждение» (osuzhdenie) is 'condemnation' throughout, and «дурной» (durnoy, 'bad') is kept plain: «Мы все дурны» is 'We are all bad'.
